items.stimulus: A county public health department keeps 3 liters of disinfectant concentrate at each of its cooling centers during a heat advisory.
items.stem: A volume of 3 liters is equivalent to how many milliliters? (1 liter = 1,000 milliliters)
items.explanation: Liters cancel when you multiply by milliliters over liters: $3 \text{ L} \times \frac{1{,}000 \text{ mL}}{1 \text{ L}} = 3{,}000 \text{ mL}$. Milliliters are the smaller unit, so the number should get bigger, and it does.

A.why: You divided 3 by 1,000 when you should have multiplied, so you converted the wrong way. A smaller unit has to give a bigger number, not a smaller one.

B.why: You used 100 milliliters per liter instead of the 1,000 given, so your answer is too small by a factor of 10.

D.why: You added an extra zero when you multiplied. $3 \times 1{,}000$ is 3,000, not 30,000.

items.stem: A labour economist studying unpaid overtime found that one employee worked a total of 7,200 minutes of unrecorded overtime in a year. The economist reports overtime in standard workdays, where 1 workday is 8 hours. How many workdays is 7,200 minutes equivalent to?
